Book.Name: Śrīmad Bhagavad-gītā. The Hidden Treasure of the Sweet Absolute

Sloka.Transcription: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvācha dharma-kṣetre kuru-kṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāś chaiva kim akurvata sañjaya
Sloka.Translation: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: O Sañjaya, what happened when my sons and the sons of Pāṇḍu assembled for battle at the holy place of Kurukṣetra?

Vocabulary.Translation: at the holy land of Kurukṣetra
